main_claim: Exact same-cell morphology contains reporter-specific information beyond condition means and coarse size/shape shortcuts, while quantitative amplitude and physical screen transfer remain separable fidelity limits.

panel_a.estimator: frozen reporter-specific MLP; arithmetic mean across five frozen held-out-gene folds
panel_a.uncertainty: reporter-resampled 95% bootstrap interval for the mean paired exact-minus-control effect

panel_b.pairing: exact and residual score within reporter

panel_c.aggregation: element-wise unweighted median of ten aligned out-of-fold model predictions
panel_c.selection: three preselected reconstruction modes; registered pRb microscopy crop
panel_c.magnitude_display: all 1000 paired genes on full-range linear axes; denser point rendering does not change data
panel_c.prb_zoom: additional linear 0–5 by 0–5 display; 996 points inside and four outside remain in the full-range view; statistics use all 1000

panel_d.aggregation: ten methods displayed separately; no model averaging
panel_d.selection: two preselected physical transfer directions plus all 81 directions
